title: Custom OIDC Auth Provider
description: A custom OpenID Connect authentication platform where developers can create an app, generate a client ID and client secret, configure their auth settings, and use this service as an authentication provider for their own applications.
features: Client ID and client secret generation
Built for integrating auth into external apps

title: Parcha95 Form Builder
description: A modern form builder built with a tRPC-based API and monorepo setup using Next.js. It allows users to create and manage forms with a clean full-stack architecture.
